title: 🏦 PFRDA Launches NPS Swasthya Pension Scheme — 25% Medical Withdrawal in Regulatory Sandbox
summary: PFRDA launched contributory NPS Swasthya Pension under Regulatory Sandbox allowing partial withdrawals up to 25% of contributions for OPD/IPD expenses after ₹50,000 corpus, and 100% exit for critical illnesses exceeding 70% of corpus.
